title: Sachbeschädigungen an und Diebstahl von Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Election posters were torn down from a lamp post and damaged, with a sticker added to one. Police Staatsschutz is investigating; the case is linked to the Berlin state election. Separately, two teenagers were caught trying to steal election posters in Zehlendorf.
